Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027 – full job details

Through the Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027, Deltek, the US-based maker of project-management and ERP software for government contractors and professional-services firms, has opened an Associate Software Engineer post in India. The listing sits under Engineering, carries Job ID 11351BR and went live on 20 November 2026.

For the Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027, the work setup is marked Remote and the location reads India (Remote). One detail to note: the browser title of the job page says Bengaluru, Karnataka, while the job body only says India (Remote). We have reported both as they appear. The role does not require travel, according to the listing.

Check before you apply to the Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027: the listing does not name a degree, graduation year, CGPA cut-off, experience range, employment type or salary. It also shows Bengaluru in the page title but India (Remote) as the location. If you get a call, ask the recruiter whether you can work from anywhere in India and whether any office visits are expected.

To submit the form on Deltek’s careers site you must accept its Functional cookies first; the apply button stays locked until you do.

What you will do in the Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027 role

In plain terms, the Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027 role is a junior developer seat on Deltek’s enterprise products. Our summary of the duties listed:

  • Help build and improve enterprise software, from APIs and backend services to databases, user screens and workflow automation.
  • Work across desktop, client/server, n-tier, on-premises, SaaS and cloud setups, depending on the product.
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools to plan, write, test, review and refine code.
  • Take part in code reviews, automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Work with product, UX, QA and fellow engineers to turn customer problems into working features.
  • Try out AI features such as copilots, agentic workflows, natural-language interfaces and smart insights.
  • Keep picking up new frameworks, tools and engineering practices as the business needs change.

Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027 eligibility

Deltek describes the profile it wants rather than a strict cut-off. Based on the qualifications section, you should have:

  • Hands-on work in at least one object-oriented language such as .NET, Java or JavaScript, built through college projects, internships or personal projects.
  • A working grasp of application architecture, APIs, databases and software design principles.
  • Some experience using GenAI or AI-assisted tools for coding, testing, debugging, documentation or learning.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving ability, plus clear communication and teamwork.
  • Genuine interest in enterprise software, modern architectures and new technology, with a habit of learning fast.

Not confirmed by Deltek: required degree (B.E./B.Tech, MCA or similar), eligible batch (2025, 2026 or 2027), CGPA, backlog policy and the exact experience range. Treat any batch or degree claim you see elsewhere as unverified. Because projects and internships are named as valid experience, freshers with solid coding work are clearly in scope.

Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027 selection process

The selection process for this Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027 role is not published. Plan for the rounds that product companies usually run for associate engineers, but do not treat this list as official:

  1. Resume shortlisting against the OOP, API and database skills in the listing.
  2. An online coding or technical assessment (data structures, a language of your choice, SQL basics).
  3. One or two technical interviews covering your projects, OOP concepts, APIs and how you use AI coding tools.
  4. A hiring-manager or HR conversation on communication, teamwork and remote-work readiness.

Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027 expected salary

Deltek has not disclosed pay for the Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027. AmbitionBox shows an estimated ₹8.2–10.5 LPA for a Deltek Associate Software Engineer and an estimated ₹7.2–9.2 LPA for Deltek freshers. Both are algorithmic estimates rather than a large pool of verified salaries, so use the combined ₹7.2–10.5 LPA only as a guide and ask HR for the full break-up in writing.

How to apply for Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027

  1. Open the official Deltek Associate Software Engineer job page.
  2. Accept the Functional cookies prompt so the apply form unlocks.
  3. Enter your name and email, agree to the terms and continue to the application.
  4. Upload your resume, fill in education and project details, and submit.
  5. Save Job ID 11351BR for any follow-up with the recruiter.

There is no closing date on the Deltek Off Campus Drive 2027 listing, so apply early; remote entry-level roles tend to fill quickly.

About Deltek

Deltek builds project-based business software, including ERP, project management and government-contracting tools such as Costpoint, Vantagepoint and Maconomy. Headquartered in Herndon, Virginia, it serves architecture, engineering, consulting and government-contracting firms worldwide. Learn more on the Deltek careers site.
